angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,154,862 km at 507.97 pc = 0.03 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 1.9686 +/- 0.0136 mas (same row, RUWE 0.90): 507.97 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.66 +/- 0.19 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TrES-4 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 1,154,862 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.08 +/- 0.38 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TrES-4 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6200 +/- 75 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TrES-4 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TrES-4 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/tres-4.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.031, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TrES-4 (pscomppars): spectral type F8 V, from Mandushev et al. 2007 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2007ApJ...667L.195M/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-2124: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TrES-4 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.14 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TrES-4 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.72552, from Daemgen et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009A%26A...498..567D/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TrES-4 (pscomppars): age 2.2 Gyr, from Meech et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.539.1381M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TrES-4 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 8.5 km/s, from Meech et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.539.1381M/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
